# Dr Adorable Mustard Seed Oil 8 Oz: A Versatile Oil for Skin, Hair, and Massage

Looking for a multipurpose oil to add to your routine? Dr Adorable Mustard Seed Oil brings the traditional Indian massage and skin care staple to your home in an 8 oz bottle. Rated 4.5 stars by 147 shoppers, it works as a base for homemade skin care and a hair treatment.

## Versatile for Body and Hair Care

Mustard seed oil is a natural ingredient for personal care. Blend it into homemade soaps, creams, and lotions, or use it as a massage oil. Many people also use it to soothe chapped lips, diaper rash, and dry skin. Its flexible usage rate, from 1% to 100%, lets you adjust it to suit your formula.

## Nourishment for Your Scalp and Hair

Mustard seed oil contains omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, along with vitamins A and E. Massaging it into your scalp can help condition hair and support its strength. Its antioxidant content may also make it a useful part of a hair care routine.

## Simple Scalp Routine

For a hair treatment, massage the oil into your scalp and hair three or more times a week. Leave it in for at least three hours before rinsing with shampoo. Consistent use can leave your hair feeling conditioned and looking healthier.

Order your Dr Adorable Mustard Seed Oil today and discover how one versatile bottle can fit into your skin and hair care routine.
